steps: Use an isolated clone/worktree of the exact baseline; never overwrite another editor.

At the exact bound baseline only, review/apply PRODUCTION_PATCH.diff with git apply --unidiff-zero. Full before/after source bytes are included for contextual review. Do not overwrite a changed branch.

Copy production_assets/geologist_washing_pan_painted.png and its .import.txt metadata to the declared runtime_asset_path and .import. Verify the preserved PNG and exact script hashes in PRODUCTION_STATUS.json.

Run exact Godot4.7.2 import, native fixture and unmodified full trusted CI. Native fixture uses a declared own saved-PAN checkpoint and real Main library-room launcher; it is not naturally earned whole-route or formalQA11 acceptance.
